units.translation: With ⟦1⟧ the establishment of the Areopagus and specifically of the entire legal procedure before it is indicated (484, 615, 681); one must not now think that the establishment speech of Athena (681 ff.) would have to follow here immediately, but rather from the ⟦2⟧ a part appears at once with the constituting council, for which reason at 615 Apollo addresses the council as ⟦3⟧. On the one hand this concerns the whole city, for now and for all future time, 572 (⟦4⟧ to 416), on the other hand it concerns the present lawsuit, which is to be conducted first: 573 ⟦5⟧ (⟦6⟧) ⟦7⟧. Compare with this below in the speech of Athena: 707 ff. ⟦8⟧; ⟦9⟧. – Since ⟦10⟧ ordinarily means not 'to recognize exactly' but 'to decide to someone's disadvantage', Paley demands ⟦11⟧ (cf. 709), for which, however, ⟦12⟧ is not the correct adverb. Cf. Aristoph. ⟦13⟧. 46 (Wakef.), Xen. Oecon. 2, 18.
so that the case may be decided well
this advice I have extended to my citizens for the future
but you must stand upright and cast your vote and decide the case
to decide a case against someone

⟦1⟧ is better than ⟦2⟧, with ⟦3⟧ (of Orestes and the Erinyes); the ⟦4⟧ corresponding to ⟦5⟧ is indeed freer in construction, but still understandable: and for the present, so that the lawsuit of the parties present may be accurately decided.

Meanwhile Apollo has appeared (cf. his promise at 81 ff.), and the chorus wants to drive him away. In response, Apollo declares that on the one hand he is a witness (cf. Athena's summons to the parties at 485f.), which he justifies by his close relationship to the accused as his ⟦1⟧, and on the other hand a legal advocate, who conducts Orestes' case as his own, as the author (⟦2⟧) of the matricide. The scholiast does not explain quite correctly: ⟦3⟧, for according to 761 the Erinyes are ⟦4⟧ of the mother, and in Athens this is the name for legal advocates, whom, for example, the people elect for a contested law, Dem. 20, 146, each tribe for an accused belonging to it, Andok. 1, end, Dem. 23, 206 (Meier-Schömann-Lipsius Att. Proc. 123f.).
syndikoi are those who have an equal share in the case of the accusation
At V. 576 f. the tradition is corrupted: ⟦1⟧ (⟦2⟧ M first) ⟦3⟧ (⟦4⟧ M first) ⟦5⟧ (thus and -⟦6⟧ M, -⟦7⟧ f g h) ⟦8⟧.
for he is of the house
this man is a suppliant and of the house
